{"week":3,"skill":"Actuators and closed-loop control: modals & conditionals","items":[{"id":"grammar.w03.d01","titleArabic":"الدرس 1: تعليمات الأمان مع المرحلات (must / should)","titleEnglish":"Day 1: Safety instructions with relays (must / should)","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على استخدام الأفعال الوظائفيّة (modals) لإعطاء تعليمات أمانية تقنية: must (يجب) وshould (ينبغي). نستخدم must للإلزام القوي: قواعد، إجراءات أمان لا تتغير. نستخدم should للإشارة إلى نصيحة قوية أو أفضل ممارسة.

الشكل (Form):
- Must + base verb  → يجب: e.g. You must isolate the relay.
- Should + base verb → ينبغي / من الأفضل: e.g. You should check the relay contacts.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "You must isolate the relay before maintenance." — "يجب عزل المرحل قبل الصيانة."
2) "You should wear gloves when you test the relay coil." — "ينبغي ارتداء القفازات عند اختبار ملف المرحل."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون often "should to" بدلاً من "should" الصحيح. خطأ: "You should to check the relay." الصحيح: "You should check the relay."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. To prevent electric shock, engineers _____ lock the control panel before work.
A) should
B) should to
C) will
Answer: A

2. When a relay is hot and smoking, you _____ continue testing it.
A) must
B) mustn't
C) may
Answer: B

3. For routine inspection, technicians _____ check the relay contacts every month.
A) must
B) should
C) coulded
Answer: B

4. If a relay coil is exposed, staff _____ wear insulated gloves.
A) should
B) should to
C) mustn't
Answer: A

5. The instruction manual says you _____ disconnect power before removing the relay.
A) must
B) may
C) shoulded
Answer: A

6. For non-critical warnings, engineers _____ note the condition and monitor it.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) shoulding
Answer: A

7. You _____ ignore a visible arc inside a relay; it is dangerous.
A) mustn't
B) musted
C) should
Answer: A

8. If contacts are corroded, maintenance _____ replace them promptly.
A) should
B) shouldn't
C) may to
Answer: A

9. Safety protocol: you _____ sign out the equipment after isolation.
A) must
B) might
C) shoulded
Answer: A

10. When unsure about a fault, a junior engineer _____ ask a senior for help.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) should to
Answer: A

11. A relay with a burnt scent _____ be removed and tagged out.
A) must
B) shoulded
C) may
Answer: A

12. For better life of the relay, technicians _____ avoid overloads.
A) should
B) mayed
C) mustn't
Answer: A

13. If the relay label is missing, you _____ identify it before reconnecting.
A) must
B) should to
C) could
Answer: A

14. You _____ test a live control circuit without suitable PPE.
A) mustn't
B) should
C) will
Answer: A

15. When documentation conflicts, engineers _____ follow the safety data sheet.
A) must
B) shoulding
C) may
Answer: A

16. As a recommendation, you _____ keep a spare relay in inventory.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) may to
Answer: A

17. If the relay trips repeatedly, the technician _____ investigate the root cause.
A) must
B) shoulded
C) might
Answer: A

18. For minor cleaning, you _____ use a dry brush; do not use liquids.
A) should
B) musted
C) will
Answer: A

19. If a relay shows physical damage, you _____ not use it in the system.
A) must
B) should
C) may
Answer: A

20. During training, trainees _____ follow the senior engineer's safety checklist.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) might
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملتين (2-3 كلمات كل جملة) تشرح كيف تعزل المرحل قبل الصيانة.
2) اكتب ملاحظة أمان قصيرة بالإنجليزية (جملة واحدة) توصي بملابس الوقاية عند اختبار ملف المرحل.
"}, {"id":"grammar.w03.d02","titleArabic":"الدرس 2: الأذونات والقدرات مع المآخذ الكهرومغناطيسية (can / may / can't)","titleEnglish":"Day 2: Permissions and ability with solenoids (can / may / can't)","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على can و may و can't للتعبير عن القدرة والإذن والرفض. use can للتعبير عن القدرة أو الإمكانية؛ may للتعبير عن الإذن الرسمي؛ can't للنفي القاطع للقدرة أو الإذن.

الشكل (Form):
- Can + base verb → القدرة: e.g. The solenoid can move the plunger.
- May + base verb → إذن: e.g. You may open the manual.
- Can't + base verb → عدم القدرة أو المنع: e.g. You can't operate without certification.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "The solenoid can pull the valve pin at 12 V." — "يمكن للملف الكهرومغناطيسي جذب دبوس الصمام عند 12 فولت."
2) "You may not energise the solenoid until the valve is secure." — "لا يجوز تزويد الملف بالطاقة حتى يكون الصمام مؤمناً."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون "can not" مفصولة بدلاً من الشكل المختصر "can't" في الكلام غير الرسمي، ويتخلطون بين القدرة والإذن. تذكّر: "can" قدرة، "may" إذن رسمي.

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. The solenoid _____ operate at 24 V if the supply is stable.
A) can
B) will to
C) mustn't
Answer: A

A) may
B) can't
C) should
Answer: B

3. For testing, the technician _____ apply 12 V to check movement.
A) can
B) mayed
C) mustn't
Answer: A

4. Only the supervisor _____ give permission to energise the solenoid.
A) may
B) caned
C) mustn't
Answer: A

A) can't

Answer: A

6. During calibration, you _____ adjust the current within safe limits.
A) may

C) will
Answer: A

B) caned

Answer: A

15. If the plunger is obstructed, the solenoid _____ move freely.
A) can't
B) should
C) may
Answer: A

16. For a quick check, you _____ manually move the plunger when power is off.
A) can
B) mayn't
C) mustn't
Answer: A

17. The spec sheet says the solenoid _____ withstand short overloads.
A) can
B) may

Answer: A

18. If safety interlocks fail, you _____ not bypass them; you _____ report immediately.
A) must / should

Answer: A

19. Non-qualified staff _____ touch the wiring; only electricians _____ do so.
A) can't / may
B) may / can
C) should / mustn't
Answer: A

20. During inspection, you _____ verify the coil resistance with a meter.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة تشرح أنه لا يجوز تشغيل ملف كهرومغناطيسي قبل التأكد من تأمين الصمام.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملتين تصفان قدرة ملف كهرومغناطيسي على تحريك دبوس الصمام عند جهد محدد.
"}, {"id":"grammar.w03.d03","titleArabic":"الدرس 3: الجمل الشرطية الصفرية والمواقف الثابتة (zero conditional)","titleEnglish":"Day 3: Zero conditional and fixed technical truths","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
الجملة الشرطية الصفرية (zero conditional) تستخدم للتعبير عن حقائق عامة أو نتائج متوقعة دائماً عندما يحدث شيء. الصيغة الأساسية: If + present simple, present simple. نستخدمها لوصف سلوك النظام أو النتائج العلمية.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, present → If the valve is closed, the flow stops.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the valve is closed, the process value drops to zero." — "إذا كان الصمام مغلقًا، تنخفض قيمة العملية إلى الصفر."
2) "If the set point equals the process value, the controller holds the position." — "إذا كان نقطة الضبط مساوية لقيمة العملية، يحتفظ المتحكم بالموضع."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم البعض will في جملة شرطية صفرية: خطأ: "If the valve will close, the flow stops." الصحيح: "If the valve closes, the flow stops."

A) closes

Answer: A

Answer: A

"}, {"id":"grammar.w03.d04","titleArabic":"الدرس 4: الشرط الأول والنتائج المحتملة (first conditional)","titleEnglish":"Day 4: First conditional and possible results","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
الجملة الشرطية الأولى (first conditional) تستخدم للحديث عن نتيجة محتملة في المستقبل تعتمد على شرط واقعي. الصيغة: If + present simple, will + base verb. يمكن استخدام modals بدلاً من will للتعبير عن نصيحة أو وجوب.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, will + verb → If the process value rises, the controller will close the valve.
- If + present, should/will + verb → If you see smoke, you should stop the test.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the process value rises above the set point, the controller will close the valve." — "إذا ارتفعت قيمة العملية فوق نقطة الضبط، سيغلق المتحكم الصمام."
2) "If the valve does not respond, you should check the actuator linkage." — "إذا لم يستجب الصمام، ينبغي فحص رابط المشغل."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم البعض present continuous بعد if في الجملة الأولى: خطأ: "If the process is rising, the controller will..." (يمكن قبوله لكن الأفضل: If the process value rises, ...). تجنب will في الجملة الشرطية الأولى قبل الفاصلة: خطأ: "If the process value will rise, the controller will..."

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة شرطية أولى تصف ما سيحدث إذا فشل الصمام في الاستجابة.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية نصيحة تقنية قصيرة باستخدام should بعد جملة شرطية (If ... , you should ...)."}, {"id":"grammar.w03.d05","titleArabic":"الدرس 5: دمج المودال والشرطي (إجراءات السلامة المشروطة)","titleEnglish":"Day 5: Combining modals and conditionals (conditional safety procedures)","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
هذا الدرس يعلّم كيفية دمج الأفعال الوظائفية مع الجمل الشرطية لوصف إجراءات أمان مشروطة. يمكننا استخدام first conditional مع must/should/have to لشرح ما يجب فعله عندما يحدث شرط معين.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, must/should + base verb → e.g. If the process value rises, you must shut the valve.
- If + present, will + have to → e.g. If alarms continue, you will have to isolate the line.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the process value exceeds the safety limit, you must shut the valve immediately." — "إذا تجاوزت قيمة العملية الحد الآمن، يجب إغلاق الصمام فوراً."
2) "If the position does not change after reset, you should report to maintenance." — "إذا لم يتغير الموضع بعد إعادة الضبط، ينبغي الإبلاغ عن ذلك للصيانة."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يخلط البعض بين must وhave to. تذكر: يمكن استخدام have to للتعبير عن ضرورة خارجية (قواعد)، وmust للأمر الذاتي. لا تكتب "If ... must you ..."؛ الترتيب الصحيح بعد الفاصلة.

"}, {"id":"grammar.w03.d06","titleArabic":"الدرس 6: النهي والالتزام (mustn't / have to / ought to)","titleEnglish":"Day 6: Prohibition and obligation (mustn't / have to / ought to)","promptTemplateId":"grammar-lesson-v1","sourceUrls":["https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/modals","https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/grammar/english-grammar-reference/zero-and-first-conditionals"],"contentMarkdown":"شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على الكلمات التي تعبر عن النهي والالتزام: mustn't (يحظر)، have to (يجب) وought to (من الأفضل). mustn't يستخدم للنهي القاطع، have to للتزام خارجي، ought to كنصيحة قوية.

الشكل (Form):
- Mustn't + base verb → الحظر: e.g. You mustn't bypass the safety interlock.
- Have to + base verb → الاضطرار: e.g. You have to follow company rules.
- Ought to + base verb → من الأفضل: e.g. You ought to check seals.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "You mustn't bypass the safety interlock during operation." — "لا يحل لك تجاوز قاطع الأمان أثناء التشغيل."
2) "You have to document every valve adjustment." — "يجب عليك توثيق كل تعديل للصمام."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يترجم البعض 'have to' حرفيًا إلى «يملك أن»، وينسون أنها تعني ضرورة خارجية. تجنّب قول "I have to to..."؛ الصيغة الصحيحة: "I have to document."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. During normal operation, you _____ bypass safety systems.
A) mustn't
B) ought
C) will
Answer: A

2. Company rule: you _____ log each calibration.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

3. In practice, engineers _____ keep a maintenance record; it is best practice.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

4. You _____ remove guards while machinery runs.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

5. If the label is missing, you _____ replace it before reuse.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) shoulding
Answer: A

6. During tests, you _____ not exceed rated current; it is forbidden.
A) mustn't
B) can
C) may
Answer: A

7. If documentation is incomplete, the technician _____ complete it.
A) has to
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

8. For safety culture, you _____ report near misses.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

9. You _____ operate equipment without a permit-to-work when required.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

10. If the set point _____ outside limits, you _____ stop the process.
A) is / have to
B) will / may
C) was / can
Answer: A

11. You _____ not use improvisation to secure a valve; it's forbidden.
A) mustn't
B) ought to
C) may
Answer: A

12. For traceability, engineers _____ sign all adjustments.
A) have to
B) mayn't
C) could
Answer: A

13. You _____ consider temperature effects when selecting seals; it's recommended.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) can
Answer: A

14. If a part is damaged, you _____ not reinstall it.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) ought to
Answer: A

15. Regulatory rules say you _____ keep inspection logs for five years.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) might
Answer: A

16. For better safety, you _____ wear eye protection near valves.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

17. You _____ operate a control panel with wet hands.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

18. If alarms continue after reset, you _____ escalate to senior engineer.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) ought to
Answer: A

19. For best practice, you _____ schedule preventive maintenance every quarter.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

20. If an uncertified contractor requests access, you _____ refuse until paperwork is complete.
A) must
B) may
C) mightn't
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة تحظر إجراءً خطيرًا على خط أنابيب.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة توضح ضرورة توثيق تعديل صمام (use have to).

الشكل (Form):

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If an unexpected movement occurs, you must press the emergency stop button." — "إذا حدث حركة غير متوقعة، يجب الضغط على زر التوقف الطارئ."

items.titleArabic: الدرس 1: تعليمات الأمان مع المرحلات (must / should)
items.titleEnglish: Day 1: Safety instructions with relays (must / should)
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على استخدام الأفعال الوظائفيّة (modals) لإعطاء تعليمات أمانية تقنية: must (يجب) وshould (ينبغي). نستخدم must للإلزام القوي: قواعد، إجراءات أمان لا تتغير. نستخدم should للإشارة إلى نصيحة قوية أو أفضل ممارسة.

الشكل (Form):
- Must + base verb  → يجب: e.g. You must isolate the relay.
- Should + base verb → ينبغي / من الأفضل: e.g. You should check the relay contacts.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "You must isolate the relay before maintenance." — "يجب عزل المرحل قبل الصيانة."
2) "You should wear gloves when you test the relay coil." — "ينبغي ارتداء القفازات عند اختبار ملف المرحل."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون often "should to" بدلاً من "should" الصحيح. خطأ: "You should to check the relay." الصحيح: "You should check the relay."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. To prevent electric shock, engineers _____ lock the control panel before work.
A) should
B) should to
C) will
Answer: A

2. When a relay is hot and smoking, you _____ continue testing it.
A) must
B) mustn't
C) may
Answer: B

3. For routine inspection, technicians _____ check the relay contacts every month.
A) must
B) should
C) coulded
Answer: B

4. If a relay coil is exposed, staff _____ wear insulated gloves.
A) should
B) should to
C) mustn't
Answer: A

5. The instruction manual says you _____ disconnect power before removing the relay.
A) must
B) may
C) shoulded
Answer: A

6. For non-critical warnings, engineers _____ note the condition and monitor it.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) shoulding
Answer: A

7. You _____ ignore a visible arc inside a relay; it is dangerous.
A) mustn't
B) musted
C) should
Answer: A

8. If contacts are corroded, maintenance _____ replace them promptly.
A) should
B) shouldn't
C) may to
Answer: A

9. Safety protocol: you _____ sign out the equipment after isolation.
A) must
B) might
C) shoulded
Answer: A

10. When unsure about a fault, a junior engineer _____ ask a senior for help.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) should to
Answer: A

11. A relay with a burnt scent _____ be removed and tagged out.
A) must
B) shoulded
C) may
Answer: A

12. For better life of the relay, technicians _____ avoid overloads.
A) should
B) mayed
C) mustn't
Answer: A

13. If the relay label is missing, you _____ identify it before reconnecting.
A) must
B) should to
C) could
Answer: A

14. You _____ test a live control circuit without suitable PPE.
A) mustn't
B) should
C) will
Answer: A

15. When documentation conflicts, engineers _____ follow the safety data sheet.
A) must
B) shoulding
C) may
Answer: A

16. As a recommendation, you _____ keep a spare relay in inventory.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) may to
Answer: A

17. If the relay trips repeatedly, the technician _____ investigate the root cause.
A) must
B) shoulded
C) might
Answer: A

18. For minor cleaning, you _____ use a dry brush; do not use liquids.
A) should
B) musted
C) will
Answer: A

19. If a relay shows physical damage, you _____ not use it in the system.
A) must
B) should
C) may
Answer: A

20. During training, trainees _____ follow the senior engineer's safety checklist.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) might
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملتين (2-3 كلمات كل جملة) تشرح كيف تعزل المرحل قبل الصيانة.
2) اكتب ملاحظة أمان قصيرة بالإنجليزية (جملة واحدة) توصي بملابس الوقاية عند اختبار ملف المرحل.

items.titleArabic: الدرس 2: الأذونات والقدرات مع المآخذ الكهرومغناطيسية (can / may / can't)
items.titleEnglish: Day 2: Permissions and ability with solenoids (can / may / can't)
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على can و may و can't للتعبير عن القدرة والإذن والرفض. use can للتعبير عن القدرة أو الإمكانية؛ may للتعبير عن الإذن الرسمي؛ can't للنفي القاطع للقدرة أو الإذن.

الشكل (Form):
- Can + base verb → القدرة: e.g. The solenoid can move the plunger.
- May + base verb → إذن: e.g. You may open the manual.
- Can't + base verb → عدم القدرة أو المنع: e.g. You can't operate without certification.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "The solenoid can pull the valve pin at 12 V." — "يمكن للملف الكهرومغناطيسي جذب دبوس الصمام عند 12 فولت."
2) "You may not energise the solenoid until the valve is secure." — "لا يجوز تزويد الملف بالطاقة حتى يكون الصمام مؤمناً."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم المتعلمون "can not" مفصولة بدلاً من الشكل المختصر "can't" في الكلام غير الرسمي، ويتخلطون بين القدرة والإذن. تذكّر: "can" قدرة، "may" إذن رسمي.

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. The solenoid _____ operate at 24 V if the supply is stable.
A) can
B) will to
C) mustn't
Answer: A

2. You _____ enter the control room without authority.
A) may
B) can't
C) should
Answer: B

3. For testing, the technician _____ apply 12 V to check movement.
A) can
B) mayed
C) mustn't
Answer: A

4. Only the supervisor _____ give permission to energise the solenoid.
A) may
B) caned
C) mustn't
Answer: A

5. If wiring is loose, the solenoid _____ work correctly.
A) can't
B) may
C) should
Answer: A

6. During calibration, you _____ adjust the current within safe limits.
A) may
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

7. A trainee _____ operate the solenoid alone without training.
A) can't
B) may
C) shoulded
Answer: A

8. If the spec allows, the engineer _____ use a 24 V coil.
A) can
B) mustn't
C) mayed
Answer: A

9. You _____ disconnect the solenoid while power is applied.
A) mustn't
B) can
C) may
Answer: A

10. For documentation, you _____ record the voltage and current values.
A) should
B) can
C) mayn't
Answer: B

11. A replaced solenoid _____ be tested before commissioning.
A) must
B) may
C) can't
Answer: A

12. If the vendor allows, you _____ order a different coil size.
A) may
B) can't
C) shoulded
Answer: A

13. A weak supply _____ reduce pull force; the solenoid _____ fail to actuate.
A) can / may
B) must / can
C) may / should
Answer: A

14. Contractors _____ not energise field devices after hours.
A) must
B) caned
C) may
Answer: A

15. If the plunger is obstructed, the solenoid _____ move freely.
A) can't
B) should
C) may
Answer: A

16. For a quick check, you _____ manually move the plunger when power is off.
A) can
B) mayn't
C) mustn't
Answer: A

17. The spec sheet says the solenoid _____ withstand short overloads.
A) can
B) may
C) mustn't
Answer: A

18. If safety interlocks fail, you _____ not bypass them; you _____ report immediately.
A) must / should
B) can / will
C) may / might
Answer: A

19. Non-qualified staff _____ touch the wiring; only electricians _____ do so.
A) can't / may
B) may / can
C) should / mustn't
Answer: A

20. During inspection, you _____ verify the coil resistance with a meter.
A) should
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة تشرح أنه لا يجوز تشغيل ملف كهرومغناطيسي قبل التأكد من تأمين الصمام.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملتين تصفان قدرة ملف كهرومغناطيسي على تحريك دبوس الصمام عند جهد محدد.

items.titleArabic: الدرس 3: الجمل الشرطية الصفرية والمواقف الثابتة (zero conditional)
items.titleEnglish: Day 3: Zero conditional and fixed technical truths
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
الجملة الشرطية الصفرية (zero conditional) تستخدم للتعبير عن حقائق عامة أو نتائج متوقعة دائماً عندما يحدث شيء. الصيغة الأساسية: If + present simple, present simple. نستخدمها لوصف سلوك النظام أو النتائج العلمية.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, present → If the valve is closed, the flow stops.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the valve is closed, the process value drops to zero." — "إذا كان الصمام مغلقًا، تنخفض قيمة العملية إلى الصفر."
2) "If the set point equals the process value, the controller holds the position." — "إذا كان نقطة الضبط مساوية لقيمة العملية، يحتفظ المتحكم بالموضع."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم البعض will في جملة شرطية صفرية: خطأ: "If the valve will close, the flow stops." الصحيح: "If the valve closes, the flow stops."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. If the valve _____ fully, flow stops.
A) closes
B) will close
C) closed
Answer: A

2. If the set point _____ lower than the process value, the controller reduces output.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

3. If the actuator _____ blocked, the position does not change.
A) is
B) will be
C) would be
Answer: A

4. If the process value _____ unstable, the system trips.
A) becomes
B) will become
C) becomeed
Answer: A

5. If the valve seat _____ worn, leakage occurs.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

6. If the power supply _____ lost, alarms sound.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

7. If the control loop _____ closed, the controller maintains the set point.
A) is
B) will be
C) are
Answer: A

8. If the signal cable _____ damaged, measurements are wrong.
A) is
B) will
C) was
Answer: A

9. If the temperature _____ high, the valve expands.
A) is
B) will be
C) had been
Answer: A

10. If the operator _____ the emergency stop, the system shuts down.
A) presses
B) will press
C) pressed
Answer: A

11. If the dashed line _____ visible, the gauge is faulty.
A) is
B) will be
C) would be
Answer: A

12. If the solenoid _____ energised, the pin retracts.
A) is
B) will be
C) had been
Answer: A

13. If the set point _____ lower than allowed, alarms trigger.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

14. If the wiring _____ loose, the contact will fail.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

15. If the actuator _____ cooled, friction reduces.
A) is
B) will be
C) had been
Answer: A

16. If the hydraulic pressure _____ zero, the valve cannot move.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

17. If the indicator lamp _____ off, the circuit is open.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

18. If the process value _____ steady, control effort is minimal.
A) is
B) will be
C) had been
Answer: A

19. If the manual override _____ engaged, automatic control stops.
A) is
B) will be
C) are
Answer: A

20. If the calibration _____ correct, readings match the standard.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة شرطية صفرية تصف نتيجة إغلاق الصمام.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة شرطية صفرية تصف علاقة ثابتة بين قيمة العملية ونقطة الضبط.

items.titleArabic: الدرس 4: الشرط الأول والنتائج المحتملة (first conditional)
items.titleEnglish: Day 4: First conditional and possible results
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
الجملة الشرطية الأولى (first conditional) تستخدم للحديث عن نتيجة محتملة في المستقبل تعتمد على شرط واقعي. الصيغة: If + present simple, will + base verb. يمكن استخدام modals بدلاً من will للتعبير عن نصيحة أو وجوب.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, will + verb → If the process value rises, the controller will close the valve.
- If + present, should/will + verb → If you see smoke, you should stop the test.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the process value rises above the set point, the controller will close the valve." — "إذا ارتفعت قيمة العملية فوق نقطة الضبط، سيغلق المتحكم الصمام."
2) "If the valve does not respond, you should check the actuator linkage." — "إذا لم يستجب الصمام، ينبغي فحص رابط المشغل."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يستخدم البعض present continuous بعد if في الجملة الأولى: خطأ: "If the process is rising, the controller will..." (يمكن قبوله لكن الأفضل: If the process value rises, ...). تجنب will في الجملة الشرطية الأولى قبل الفاصلة: خطأ: "If the process value will rise, the controller will..."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. If the process value _____ the limit, the system will alarm.
A) exceeds
B) will exceed
C) exceeding
Answer: A

2. If the valve _____ to close, the machine will stop.
A) fails
B) will fail
C) failed
Answer: A

3. If you _____ smoke, you should press the emergency stop.
A) see
B) will see
C) saw
Answer: A

4. If the set point _____ wrong, the controller will adjust output.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

5. If the technician _____ the wiring, the fault may clear.
A) checks
B) will check
C) checked
Answer: A

6. If the valve position sensor _____ offline, alarms will occur.
A) goes
B) will go
C) went
Answer: A

7. If the leak _____, you should isolate the line immediately.
A) continues
B) will continue
C) continued
Answer: A

8. If the solenoid _____ not energise, the operator will report it.
A) does
B) will does
C) did
Answer: A

9. If the set point _____ increased, the controller will raise output.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

10. If the control panel _____ unlocked, security will notify maintenance.
A) remains
B) will remain
C) remained
Answer: A

11. If the voltage _____ below threshold, the device will trip.
A) falls
B) will fall
C) fell
Answer: A

12. If you _____ uncertain, you should ask for supervisor approval.
A) are
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

13. If the actuator linkage _____ jam, the valve will stay in position.
A) does
B) will do
C) did
Answer: A

14. If the calibration _____ overdue, the lab will schedule service.
A) is
B) will be
C) had been
Answer: A

15. If the process value _____ unstable, you should pause production.
A) becomes
B) will become
C) became
Answer: A

16. If the alarm _____, the team will follow emergency procedures.
A) sounds
B) will sound
C) sounded
Answer: A

17. If the replacement part _____ wrong, send it back to supplier.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

18. If the solenoid coil _____ too hot, you should power down the circuit.
A) becomes
B) will become
C) became
Answer: A

19. If the set point _____ reached, the controller will hold output steady.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

20. If the operator _____ the wrong procedure, production will stop.
A) follows
B) will follow
C) followed
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة شرطية أولى تصف ما سيحدث إذا فشل الصمام في الاستجابة.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية نصيحة تقنية قصيرة باستخدام should بعد جملة شرطية (If ... , you should ...).

items.titleArabic: الدرس 5: دمج المودال والشرطي (إجراءات السلامة المشروطة)
items.titleEnglish: Day 5: Combining modals and conditionals (conditional safety procedures)
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
هذا الدرس يعلّم كيفية دمج الأفعال الوظائفية مع الجمل الشرطية لوصف إجراءات أمان مشروطة. يمكننا استخدام first conditional مع must/should/have to لشرح ما يجب فعله عندما يحدث شرط معين.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, must/should + base verb → e.g. If the process value rises, you must shut the valve.
- If + present, will + have to → e.g. If alarms continue, you will have to isolate the line.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If the process value exceeds the safety limit, you must shut the valve immediately." — "إذا تجاوزت قيمة العملية الحد الآمن، يجب إغلاق الصمام فوراً."
2) "If the position does not change after reset, you should report to maintenance." — "إذا لم يتغير الموضع بعد إعادة الضبط، ينبغي الإبلاغ عن ذلك للصيانة."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يخلط البعض بين must وhave to. تذكر: يمكن استخدام have to للتعبير عن ضرورة خارجية (قواعد)، وmust للأمر الذاتي. لا تكتب "If ... must you ..."؛ الترتيب الصحيح بعد الفاصلة.

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. If the pressure _____ above the alarm level, you must close the manual valve.
A) rises
B) will rise
C) rose
Answer: A

2. If the valve _____ stuck, you should call maintenance.
A) gets
B) will get
C) got
Answer: A

3. If the indicator _____ off-scale, the operator must stop the pump.
A) reads
B) will read
C) read
Answer: A

4. If the position feedback _____ lost, you will have to use the manual gauge.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

5. If alarms _____ persistent, technicians must investigate immediately.
A) are
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

6. If the set point _____ changed accidentally, you should restore the previous value.
A) was
B) will be
C) is
Answer: C

7. If the solenoid _____ jammed, you must not force it.
A) is
B) will be
C) are
Answer: A

8. If the process value _____ near limit, you should monitor it closely.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

9. If the wiring _____ overheated, you must isolate power and inspect.
A) has
B) will have
C) had
Answer: A

10. If the control signal _____ noisy, you should apply a filter.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

11. If remote access _____ lost, you will have to visit the site.
A) is
B) will be
C) are
Answer: A

12. If the valve position _____ wrong, technicians must recalibrate.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

13. If the supply _____ unstable, you should schedule downtime.
A) becomes
B) will become
C) became
Answer: A

14. If the alarm lamp _____ lit, operators must follow shutdown steps.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

15. If the manual override _____ used, you must record the change.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

16. If the leak _____ detected, you should isolate the section immediately.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

17. If the system _____ in test mode, you must inform production.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

18. If parts _____ missing after inspection, technicians must report inventory.
A) are
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

19. If the actuator linkage _____ loose, you should tighten it per manual.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

20. If the set point _____ adjusted outside range, you must revert immediately.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية إجراءً موجزًا (2-3 جمل) يبدأ بIf ويستخدم must.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية تعليمات قصيرة (جملة واحدة) تبدأ بIf وتستخدم should.

items.titleArabic: الدرس 6: النهي والالتزام (mustn't / have to / ought to)
items.titleEnglish: Day 6: Prohibition and obligation (mustn't / have to / ought to)
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
في هذا الدرس نركز على الكلمات التي تعبر عن النهي والالتزام: mustn't (يحظر)، have to (يجب) وought to (من الأفضل). mustn't يستخدم للنهي القاطع، have to للتزام خارجي، ought to كنصيحة قوية.

الشكل (Form):
- Mustn't + base verb → الحظر: e.g. You mustn't bypass the safety interlock.
- Have to + base verb → الاضطرار: e.g. You have to follow company rules.
- Ought to + base verb → من الأفضل: e.g. You ought to check seals.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "You mustn't bypass the safety interlock during operation." — "لا يحل لك تجاوز قاطع الأمان أثناء التشغيل."
2) "You have to document every valve adjustment." — "يجب عليك توثيق كل تعديل للصمام."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يترجم البعض 'have to' حرفيًا إلى «يملك أن»، وينسون أنها تعني ضرورة خارجية. تجنّب قول "I have to to..."؛ الصيغة الصحيحة: "I have to document."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. During normal operation, you _____ bypass safety systems.
A) mustn't
B) ought
C) will
Answer: A

2. Company rule: you _____ log each calibration.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

3. In practice, engineers _____ keep a maintenance record; it is best practice.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

4. You _____ remove guards while machinery runs.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

5. If the label is missing, you _____ replace it before reuse.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) shoulding
Answer: A

6. During tests, you _____ not exceed rated current; it is forbidden.
A) mustn't
B) can
C) may
Answer: A

7. If documentation is incomplete, the technician _____ complete it.
A) has to
B) mustn't
C) caned
Answer: A

8. For safety culture, you _____ report near misses.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

9. You _____ operate equipment without a permit-to-work when required.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

10. If the set point _____ outside limits, you _____ stop the process.
A) is / have to
B) will / may
C) was / can
Answer: A

11. You _____ not use improvisation to secure a valve; it's forbidden.
A) mustn't
B) ought to
C) may
Answer: A

12. For traceability, engineers _____ sign all adjustments.
A) have to
B) mayn't
C) could
Answer: A

13. You _____ consider temperature effects when selecting seals; it's recommended.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) can
Answer: A

14. If a part is damaged, you _____ not reinstall it.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) ought to
Answer: A

15. Regulatory rules say you _____ keep inspection logs for five years.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) might
Answer: A

16. For better safety, you _____ wear eye protection near valves.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

17. You _____ operate a control panel with wet hands.
A) mustn't
B) have to
C) may
Answer: A

18. If alarms continue after reset, you _____ escalate to senior engineer.
A) have to
B) mustn't
C) ought to
Answer: A

19. For best practice, you _____ schedule preventive maintenance every quarter.
A) ought to
B) mustn't
C) will
Answer: A

20. If an uncertified contractor requests access, you _____ refuse until paperwork is complete.
A) must
B) may
C) mightn't
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة تحظر إجراءً خطيرًا على خط أنابيب.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة واحدة توضح ضرورة توثيق تعديل صمام (use have to).

items.titleArabic: الدرس 7: إجراءات التوقف الطارئ والتوصيات (first conditional + modals)
items.titleEnglish: Day 7: Emergency stop procedures and recommendations
items.contentMarkdown:
شرح بالعربية:
التركيز في هذا الدرس على وضع تعليمات التوقف الطارئ باستخدام الجملة الشرطية الأولى مع modals لتعطي أوامر وتوصيات واضحة. نستخدم first conditional لنتحدث عن نتيجة مستقبلية محتملة، ونستخدم modals مثل should, must, may للتدرّج بين نصيحة وإلزام.

الشكل (Form):
- If + present, will/should/must + verb → If the system alarms, you must press the emergency stop.

أمثلة ميكاترونيكس (بالإنجليزية مع ترجمة عربية):
1) "If an unexpected movement occurs, you must press the emergency stop button." — "إذا حدث حركة غير متوقعة، يجب الضغط على زر التوقف الطارئ."
2) "If the alarm persists after reset, you should isolate the circuit and call maintenance." — "إذا استمر الإنذار بعد إعادة الضبط، ينبغي عزل الدائرة واستدعاء الصيانة."

خطأ شائع من ناطقي العربية:
يقول بعض المتعلمين "If the alarm will persist..." والخطأ هنا استخدام will في جملة الشرط قبل الفاصلة. الصيغة الصحيحة: "If the alarm persists..."

أسئلة اختيار من ثلاث خيارات (20 سؤالاً):
1. If an unexpected movement _____, you must press the emergency stop.
A) occurs
B) will occur
C) occurred
Answer: A

2. If the emergency stop _____ activated, the machine will not restart automatically.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

3. If the alarm _____ after reset, you should isolate the circuit.
A) persists
B) will persist
C) persisted
Answer: A

4. If the control panel _____ smoked, you must call fire response.
A) emits
B) will emit
C) emitted
Answer: A

5. If the operator _____ unsure, they should follow the checklist.
A) are
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

6. If the panel lock _____ broken, you must not bypass it.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

7. If the machine _____ moving unexpectedly, technicians should secure moving parts.
A) starts
B) will start
C) started
Answer: A

8. If the emergency stop _____ pressed, all actuators halt.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

9. If the alarm _____ loud and continuous, you must evacuate the area.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

10. If the power _____ unstable, you should not continue production.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

11. If the indicator _____ red, you must check the cause before restart.
A) turns
B) will turn
C) turned
Answer: A

12. If safety lights _____ off, you should not enter the zone.
A) are
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

13. If the shutdown _____ unsuccessful, you must notify control room.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

14. If a fault _____ intermittent, engineers should log times and conditions.
A) is
B) will be
C) were
Answer: A

15. If an unauthorised person _____ access, you must deny entry.
A) requests
B) will request
C) requested
Answer: A

16. If the system _____ in fault mode, you should follow isolation steps.
A) remains
B) will remain
C) remained
Answer: A

17. If a fire _____ visible, you must activate the alarm and evacuate.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

18. If the emergency stop button _____ stuck, technicians should replace it.
A) becomes
B) will become
C) became
Answer: A

19. If communication _____ lost, you must switch to local control.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

20. If the override _____ used, you should record the reason and duration.
A) is
B) will be
C) was
Answer: A

مطالعات كتابية قصيرة (كتابة هندسية):
1) اكتب بالإنجليزية خطوات قصيرة (3-4 جمل) توضح ماذا تفعل عندما يحنّ زر التوقف الطارئ.
2) اكتب بالإنجليزية جملة شرطية أولى توصي بخطوة أمان باستخدام should.
